content.title: Players Championship 2026 payouts, prize money for PGA Tour players
content.text: PGA TOUR2026 Players Championship prize money payouts for each PGA Tour player Cameron JourdanGolfweekMarch 15, 2026Updated March 16, 2026, 12:51 p.m. ETPONTE VEDRA BEACH, Fla. — Cameron Young is the 2026 Players champion.Young earned his second PGA Tour win in thrilling style, making birdie on the par-3 17th and then par on the 18th, including the longest tee shot in the ShotLink era on the hole, to win by one shot over Matt Fitzpatrick.With the win, he also earns the biggest paycheck on the PGA Tour: $4.5 million.
